results.title: Multilevel SEM – lavaan.org
results.content: To fit a two-level SEM, you must specify a model for both levels, as follows:. To fit this model, using a toy dataset `Demo.twolevel` that is part of the lavaan package, you need to add the `cluster=` argument to the sem/lavaan function call:. fit <- sem(model = model, data = Demo.twolevel, cluster = "cluster")<- semmodel =data =cluster = "cluster". fit <- sem(model = model, data = Demo.twolevel, cluster = "cluster",<- semmodel =data =cluster = "cluster" verbose = TRUE, optim.method = "em")verbose = TRUEoptim.method = "em". fit <- sem(model = model, data = Demo.twolevel, cluster = "cluster",<- semmodel =data =cluster = "cluster" verbose = TRUE, optim.method = "em", em.iter.max = 20000,verbose = TRUEoptim.method = "em"em.iter.max = 20000 em.fx.tol = 1e-08, em.dx.tol = 1e-04)em.fx.tol =1e-08em.dx.tol =1e-04. A word of caution: the EM algorithm can always be forced to ‘converge’ (perhaps after changing the stopping criteria), but that does not mean you have a model/dataset combination that deserves to converge.
